text: Duration Lasting from one semester to 2 years School begins on March 1st and ends on June 30th for one semester Curricular Arrangement A. Teaching Contents Basic Chinese is mainly taught with oral conversation, intensive reading, listening and speaking, newspaper and magazine reading, phonetics, writing etc. In accordance with the actual level of the participants, culture of China and special lectures are to be given. B.Aims and methods Improvement in listening and actual speaking ability is the main aim, and consideration is given to reading and writing as well. Classroom instruction will be combined with lots of conversation practice through visiting and sightseeing, in formal discussion or seeing films and other art performances. C.Time Table From Monday to Friday classroom instruction will be given before noon; every afternoon will be time for individual study or other activities. To meet the requirements of the participants, there will be Taijiquan, calligraphy, painting, recreational and sports activities etc. D. HSK training course Because of the requirements of the participants who want to take HSK(Test for Chinese Level), there will hold a training course for about 2 months before the test. E. Class Division Those who are to study more than a semester will be enrolled in March, September every year. An examination will be given to the applicants after their arrival and the division of classes will be made according to their Chinese level. These classes will be ABC course, elementary course, intermediate course or advanced course. There will not be more than 12 students in each class. We will hold individual course in case there come 10 more students with approximately the same Chinese level during the school day. As to their timetable, we shall discuss it on some other occasion. Tuition fee RMB 15710/year Lodging Fee Single room: CNY 84/day Double room: CNY 42/bed/day
